title: loop
responsibility: Registers loop lifecycle, regression-recording, create, step, status, search, next, and evaluation commands.

inputs.name: registerLoopCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander program that receives the `loop` command, which the function adds with `program.command('loop')`. The function keeps no reference to it, so it matters only while registration runs, and it must be a Commander `Command` because `.command()` is the only method the function calls on it.

outputs.name: registerLoopCommand
outputs.description: The function returns nothing and is synchronous, so its result is the side effect of adding the `loop` command to the program with its subcommands registered under it; no subcommand action runs during registration. The subcommands are whatever registerLoopLifecycleCommands adds plus `record <loop>`, `create <name>`, `add <loop> <step>`, `complete <loop> <step>`, `status <loop>`, `search [query]`, `next <loop>`, and `evaluate <loop>`, and they matter when the CLI parses a command line.
